color_rule: Explicit Queen's Slime 0x478A33 overrides the surface tint. Non-white source tints supply fog color. All colors multiply the existing host fog color.
deferred: Camera overlays remain unimplemented; live graphics and resource reload parity remain unverified.

automatic_color.frame: physical frame zero at native resolution
automatic_color.rule: Source alpha/red/green saturation weight, alpha > 127, RGB maximum > 31, x-major f32 accumulation; preserve source argument order. Explicit color takes precedence.
